findings.text: the 'plain' arm re-implements scripts/prototypes/point_program_attribution/blocks.py::plain_primal inline (and re-does the module-attribute patch that blocks.apply owns, both present at the node's base 3c3bcfa) instead of importing the owner; it adds only the _pole_product_traced unwrap, so the capability is duplicated rather than extended

the '1% perturbation control' is computed by hand as |1.01v - v|/|v|, the constant 0.01 that never calls relative(), so 'assert control > 0.009' here and at check_record.py:122 can never fail and does not show the comparator detects a perturbation; it is a tautology, not a positive control

for variant 'current' the observed array resolves to the same file as the reference at every order (reference and observed at lines 130 and 140-143), so the Current accuracy rows compare the reference against itself and their zero relative difference is tautological rather than an independent measurement
